summary_schedule: 00:00, 06:00, 12:00 and 18:00 America/New_York; pause after terminal outcomes are reported
authorization: User: implement the plan and see the results, 2026-10-26
learner: native CHORD FlashSAC, frozen SONIC, all body and finger residuals

adaptive_changes.advance: At checkpoint, evaluate next lower assistance from frame zero over the full reference; require object mean error <=0.15m and <=0.8rad, pelvis tracking failure <=0.25, measured hand-force contact in >=0.20 of reference-contact frames, normalized wrench deficit <=1.25, and no nonfinite world.
adaptive_changes.unassisted: Separate full-reference zero-assistance cohort at every checkpoint; no in-attempt resets
adaptive_changes.stall: Stop and retain the just-saved checkpoint; never force a reduction and call it competence

dynamics_changes.target: 11-frame cubic Savitzky-Golay object COM acceleration and rotation-derived angular velocity/acceleration; use simulator mass, COM, inertia
dynamics_changes.reference_uncertainty: 11 versus 21-frame derivative discrepancy; confidence is heuristic, not calibrated
dynamics_changes.measured: Sum physical solver hand-object and non-hand-object contact wrenches about actual COM; subtract non-hand support from required wrench; exclude virtual assistance
dynamics_changes.normalization: force divided by mg; torque by mg times object bounding radius
dynamics_changes.reward: confidence * exp(-(sqrt(1+deficit^2)-1)), robust-loss exponent capped at 20; preserve every native reward
dynamics_changes.constraints: Actual simulator contacts enforce unilateral/friction/actuator constraints; no new contact QP or feasibility certificate
dynamics_changes.scope: Single rigid object with identical object mass/inertia across worlds, matching this native recipe

reporting.invalid_world: invalidate aggregate rather than drop failed world
reporting.verify: Recompute all four from saved poses and exact local mesh samples at every evaluation
reporting.reference: tier1_input_reference, local vertex sample set, not official leaderboard ground truth
reporting.cost: Report training and evaluation separately and include both in end-to-end cost; disclose integration/baseline-evaluation overhead
